draft.subject: Getting your first project going in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — it was good to hear how Summit Works is thinking about structuring the work.

Whenever you're ready to start, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
